description: Labelled traffic profiles for the honeypot dataset release. Each profile mirrors the style of configs/attack_profiles.json but adds a ground-truth category/label, randomised credentials, and optional steps so sessions are not near-duplicates. Steps: a command string, a list of alternatives (one is chosen), or {"p": probability, "cmd": ...} for an optional step. {placeholders} are filled from the pools below; held_out profiles are kept out of the DEC training set to test novelty detection. Compatibility revision 2.2.0 (2026-11-10): commands that block Cowrie's emulated shell were replaced or removed for botnet, data_exfiltration and lateral_movement; see reports/cowrie_profile_compatibility_v2/report.md. delay_range is ignored by generator 2.1.

profiles.name: botnet
profiles.description: Mirai-style dropper: fetch a file, make it executable, run it, clean up.
compat_notes: wget target changed from {ip} to {domain}: in the isolated lab wget to an IP hangs Cowrie's shell; a DNS failure is handled and wget exits. Both download commands are still recorded; neither succeeds.
